partitions: Leave one of FCX, FCY, FCZ, FDI out in turn; fit only remaining blocks.
baseline: Dependency-light fixed-effect reconstruction of trans.ability from best.p, median.ct, best.y, and rel.susc; it is not equivalent to the published random-effect model.
outcome: Held-block prediction error and calibration, reported separately by block.
claim_boundary: Only transfer across these four laboratory blocks; no biological mechanism or real-world spillover inference.
prohibited: Do not compare the reconstruction as a replacement for the published lme4 model or inspect a final result before validation implementation freeze.
